title: Split focused pane along its longer axis when opening an app
context: Opening an app should give it its own pane, not a tab in the existing pane. Repeated opening should not slice one axis into slivers.
decision: When opening an app into a pane: measure the rendered pane's dimensions in pixels in the frontend; split along the longer axis (wide pane gains right column, tall gains bottom row); pass measured direction to Rust.
consequences: Layout stays roughly square on repeated opens. Rust cannot measure pixels so frontend must do it; this keeps frontend and Rust in sync about which way is 'longer'.
